faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IGRUA Simulator Engineer-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IGRUA Simulator Engineer-I post is 26th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Simulator Engineer-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or Electronics & Communication Engineering with at least 8 years of relevant post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Simulator Engineer-I position is 55 years as of 1st July 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the IGRUA recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General, OBC, SC, ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Simulator Engineer-I position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 130,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the IGRUA Simulator Engineer-I job?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted via email. You should prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official email address before the deadline.

faq.answer: The selection process typically involves a Written Test, followed by an Interview, and Document Verification.
